english: Because in past human lives they had temporarily heard the name of Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, when in the evil destinies they temporarily recalled that Tathagata's name, at the moment of recollection they departed from that place and were reborn among humans. They gained the memory of past lives, feared the suffering of evil destinies, took no pleasure in sensual desires, delighted in practicing charitable giving, praised those who give, and had no attachment or stinginess toward all their possessions. Gradually they became able to give even their head, eyes, hands, feet, blood, flesh, and body parts to those who came seeking them, how much more so other material wealth.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利，若諸有情，雖於如來受諸學處，而破尸羅；有雖不破尸羅，而破軌則；有於尸羅、軌則，雖得不壞，然毀正見；有雖不毀正見，而棄多聞，於佛所說契經深義不能解了；有雖多聞而上慢，由增上慢覆蔽心故，自是非他，嫌謗正法，為魔伴黨。
english: Furthermore, Manjushri, among sentient beings, some, though having received the precepts from the Tathagata, break the moral discipline; some, though not breaking moral discipline, break the proper conduct; some, though maintaining both moral discipline and proper conduct without corruption, destroy right view; some, though not destroying right view, abandon extensive learning and cannot understand the profound meaning of the sutras spoken by the Buddha; some, though learned, have pride, and because pride covers their minds, they consider themselves right and others wrong, criticize and slander the true Dharma, and become companions of demons.

chinese: 如是愚人，自行邪見，復令無量俱胝有情，墮大險坑。
english: Such foolish people, practicing wrong views themselves, also cause countless billions of sentient beings to fall into great dangerous pits.

chinese: 此諸有情，應於地獄、傍生、鬼趣，流轉無窮。
english: These sentient beings should undergo endless transmigration through the hells, animal realm, and hungry ghost realm.

chinese: 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，便捨惡行，修諸善法，不墮惡趣，設有不能捨諸惡行，修行善法，墮惡趣者，以彼如來本願威力，令其現前暫聞名號，從彼命終還生人趣，得正見精進，善調意樂，便能捨家趣於非家，如來法中，受持學處，無有毀犯；正見多聞，解甚深義，離增上慢，不謗正法，不為魔，漸次修行諸菩薩行，速得圓滿。
english: If one hears the name of this Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, one will abandon evil conduct, cultivate wholesome dharmas, and not fall into evil destinies. Even if there are those who cannot abandon evil conduct and cultivate wholesome dharmas and thus fall into evil destinies, through the power of that Tathagata's original vows, upon hearing his name even briefly in their present existence, when they die they will be reborn in the human realm, attain right view and diligence, properly regulate their mental disposition, and will be able to leave home for the homeless life. In the Tathagata's Dharma, they will uphold and study the precepts without violation; with right view and extensive learning, they will understand the most profound meanings, be free from excessive pride, not slander the true Dharma, not serve demons, gradually cultivate the bodhisattva practices, and swiftly attain perfection.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!"

chinese: 若諸有情，慳貪嫉妬，自讚毀他，當墮三惡趣中，無量千歲受諸劇苦；受劇苦已，從彼命終，來生人間，作牛、馬、駝、驢，恒被鞭撻，飢渴逼惱；又負重，隨路而行。
english: If sentient beings are miserly, greedy, and jealous, praising themselves and disparaging others, they will fall into the three evil destinies and suffer intense torments for countless thousands of years. After enduring these intense sufferings, when their lives end there, they will be born in the human realm as oxen, horses, camels, and donkeys, constantly whipped and beaten, oppressed by hunger and thirst, and made to carry heavy loads as they travel along roads.

chinese: 或得為人，生居下，作人奴婢，受他驅役，恒不自在。
english: Sometimes born as a human but in a lowly position, becoming a slave or servant to others, subject to their commands and control, never having freedom.

chinese: 若昔人中，曾聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，由此善因，復憶念，至心歸依。
english: If among people of the past, they have heard the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathāgata, through this good cause, they again remember and take refuge with sincere hearts.

chinese: 以佛神力，眾苦解脫，諸根聰利，智慧多聞，恒求勝法，常遇善友，永斷魔羂，破無明，竭煩惱河，解脫一切生、老、病、死，憂、苦惱。
english: Through the Buddha's divine power, all sufferings are liberated, the faculties become sharp and keen, wisdom and learning are abundant, constantly seeking the supreme Dharma, always encountering good friends, forever severing the demon's snares, breaking through ignorance, drying up the river of afflictions, and achieving liberation from all birth, old age, sickness, death, worry, suffering, and distress.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!

chinese: 若諸有情，好憙乖離，更相鬪訟，惱亂自他，以身語意，造作增長種種惡業，展轉常為不饒益事，互相謀害。
english: If sentient beings delight in discord and separation, quarreling and fighting with one another, troubling and disturbing themselves and others, creating and accumulating various evil karma through body, speech, and mind, continuously engaging in harmful acts, and plotting against each other.

chinese: 告召山林樹塚等神；殺諸眾生，取其血肉，祭祀藥叉剎等；書怨人名，作其形像，以惡呪術而呪之；厭媚蠱道，呪起屍鬼，令斷彼命，及壞其身。
english: Summoning the spirits of mountains, forests, trees, and tombs; killing various living beings, taking their blood and flesh to make sacrificial offerings to yakṣas, rākṣasas, and others; writing the names of enemies and making their images, cursing them with evil mantras; using sorcery, enchantment, and witchcraft, invoking corpse-spirits and ghosts to cut short their lives and destroy their bodies.

chinese: 是諸有情，若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，彼諸惡事，悉不能害。
english: These sentient beings, if they hear the name of Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, all those evil things will not be able to harm them.

chinese: 一切展轉皆起慈心，利益安樂，無損惱意及嫌恨心；各各歡悅，於自所受生於喜足，不相侵，互為饒益。
english: All beings toward one another give rise to compassionate hearts, bringing benefit and happiness, without harmful intentions or feelings of resentment and hatred; each rejoices, finding contentment in what they receive, not encroaching upon others, mutually providing benefit to one another.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!"

chinese: 若有四眾：苾芻、苾芻尼、鄔波索迦、鄔波斯迦，及餘淨信善男子、善女人等，有能受持八分齋戒，經一年，或復三月，受持學處，以此善根，願生西方極樂世界無量壽佛所，聽聞正法，而未定者。
english: If there are members of the four assemblies: monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen, as well as other faithful good men and good women, who are able to uphold the eight-fold fasting precepts for one year, or alternatively for three months, upholding the training rules, and with these wholesome roots, wish to be born in the Western Pure Land of Bliss at the place of Amitayus Buddha, to hear the true Dharma, but are not yet certain [of rebirth].

chinese: 若聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，臨命終時，有八薩，來，示其道路，即於彼界種種雜色眾寶華中，自然化生。
english: If one hears the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Buddha Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, at the time of death, eight bodhisattvas will come to show the path, and one will naturally be born by transformation among the various colored jeweled flowers of that realm.

chinese: 或有因此生於天上，雖生天中，而本善根亦未窮盡，不復更生諸餘惡趣。
english: Some may be born in the heavens because of this, and though born in the heavenly realms, their original good roots are not yet exhausted, and they will not be reborn in any other evil destinies.

chinese: 天上壽盡，還生人間，或為輪王，統攝四洲，威德自在，安立無量百千有情於十善道；或生剎帝利、婆羅門、居士大家，多饒財寶，倉庫盈溢，形相端嚴，眷屬具足，聰明智慧，勇健威猛，如大力士。
english: When their lifespan in heaven is exhausted, they are reborn in the human realm, either as wheel-turning kings who rule over the four continents with majestic virtue and sovereignty, establishing countless hundreds of thousands of sentient beings on the path of the ten virtuous deeds; or they are born into great families of kṣatriyas, brahmins, or householders, possessing abundant wealth and treasures with overflowing storehouses, having handsome appearances, complete retinues, intelligence and wisdom, courage and might like great warriors.

chinese: 若是女人，得聞世尊藥師名號，至心受持，於後不復更受女身。
english: If a woman hears the name of the World-Honored Medicine Buddha and receives and upholds it with utmost sincerity, she will never again be reborn in a female body.

chinese: 」時，曼殊室利童子白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Manjushri the youth said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我當誓於像法轉時，以種種方便，令諸淨信善男子、善女人等，得聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，乃至睡中亦以佛名覺悟其耳。
english: I vow that when the age of the semblance Dharma turns, through various skillful means, I will cause all faithful good men and good women to hear the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathāgata, and even awaken their ears with the Buddha's name while they sleep.

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若於此經受持讀誦，或復為他演說開示；若自書，若人書；恭敬尊重，以種種花香、塗香、香、燒香、花鬘、瓔珞、幡蓋、伎樂，而為供養；以五色綵，作囊盛之；掃灑淨處，敷設高座，而用安處。
english: If one receives, upholds, reads, and recites this sutra, or again expounds and explains it for others; whether copying it oneself or having others copy it; respectfully honoring it with various flowers and incense, perfumes, aromatic powders, burning incense, flower garlands, jeweled necklaces, banners and canopies, music and performances as offerings; making a bag of five-colored silk to contain it; sweeping and sprinkling clean a place, arranging a high seat, and using it to place [the sutra] there.

chinese: 爾時，四大天王與其眷屬，及餘無量百千天眾，皆詣其所，供養守護。
english: At that time, the Four Great Heavenly Kings with their retinues, along with countless other hundreds of thousands of heavenly beings, all went to that place to make offerings and provide protection.

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若此經寶流行之處，有能受持，以彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來本願功德，及聞名號，當知是處無復橫死；亦復不為諸惡鬼神，奪其精氣；設已奪者，還得如故，身心安樂。
english: Wherever this precious sutra circulates, if there are those who can receive and uphold it, through the merit and virtue of the original vows of that World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and through hearing his name, know that in such places there will no longer be untimely deaths; nor will evil spirits and demons steal away their vital essence; even if it has already been stolen, it will be restored as before, with body and mind at peace and joy.

chinese: 」佛告曼殊室利：「如是！
english: The Buddha told Manjushri: "So it is!

chinese: 如是！
english: Thus it is!

chinese: 如汝所說。
english: As you have said.

chinese: 曼殊室利！
english: Manjushri!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，欲供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，應先造立彼佛形像，敷清淨座而安處之；散種種花，燒種種香，以種種幢幡莊嚴其處；七日七夜，受八分齋戒，食清淨食，澡浴香潔，著新淨衣，應生無垢濁心，無怒害心，於一切有情，起利益安樂，慈、悲、喜、捨，平等之心，鼓樂歌讚，右繞佛像。
english: If there are faithful good men and good women who wish to make offerings to the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, they should first create and establish an image of that Buddha, spread out a pure seat and place it there; scatter various flowers, burn various incense, and adorn the place with various banners and flags; for seven days and seven nights, observe the eight-fold precepts, eat pure food, bathe with fragrant cleansing, wear new clean clothes, and should generate an undefiled mind, a mind without anger or harm, toward all sentient beings, arouse beneficial and peaceful, loving-kindness, compassion, joy, equanimity, and impartial mind, play music and sing praises, and circumambulate the Buddha image to the right.

chinese: 復應念彼如來本願功德，誦此經，思惟其義，演說開示。
english: Again, one should contemplate the original vows and merits of that Tathagata, recite this sutra, reflect on its meaning, and expound and reveal it.

chinese: 隨所樂，一切皆遂：求長壽得長壽，求富饒得富饒，求官位得官位，求男女得男女。
english: According to one's desires, everything is fulfilled: those who seek longevity obtain longevity, those who seek wealth obtain wealth, those who seek official position obtain official position, those who seek sons and daughters obtain sons and daughters.

chinese: 若復有人，忽得惡夢，見諸惡相，或怪鳥來集，或於住處，百怪出現；此人若以眾妙資，恭敬供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，惡夢惡相，諸不吉祥，皆悉隱沒，不能為患。
english: If there is another person who suddenly has evil dreams, sees various evil signs, or strange birds come to gather, or in their dwelling place, a hundred strange phenomena appear; if this person uses various wonderful offerings to respectfully make offerings to that World-Honored One Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, then evil dreams, evil signs, and all inauspicious things will all disappear and be unable to cause harm.

chinese: 或有水、火、刀、毒、懸嶮、惡象、師子、虎、狼、熊、羆、毒蛇、惡蠍、蜈蚣、蚰、蚊虻等怖；若能至心憶念彼佛，恭敬供養，一切怖畏皆得解脫。
english: There may be fears of water, fire, knives, poison, precipices, evil elephants, lions, tigers, wolves, bears, poisonous snakes, evil scorpions, centipedes, house centipedes, mosquitoes, gadflies, and such terrors; if one can wholeheartedly remember and contemplate that Buddha with reverent offerings, all fears will be liberated.

chinese: 若他國侵擾，盜賊反亂；憶念恭敬彼如來者，亦皆解脫。
english: If other countries invade and cause disturbance, or bandits rebel in revolt, those who remember and respectfully revere that Tathagata will also all be liberated.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，乃至盡形不事餘天，當一心歸佛、法、僧，受持禁戒，若五戒、十戒、菩薩四百戒、苾芻二百五十戒、苾芻尼五百戒，於所受中或有毀犯，怖墮惡趣，若能專念彼佛名號，恭敬供養者，必定不受三惡趣生。
english: If there are faithful good men and good women who, throughout their entire lives, do not serve other deities, and with single-minded devotion take refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, and uphold the precepts—whether the five precepts, ten precepts, the four hundred bodhisattva precepts, the two hundred and fifty bhikṣu precepts, or the five hundred bhikṣuṇī precepts—should they violate any of these precepts they have received and fear falling into evil destinies, if they can single-mindedly recite that Buddha's name and make respectful offerings, they will definitely not be reborn in the three evil destinies.

chinese: 或有女人，臨當產時，受於極苦；若能至心稱名禮讚，恭敬供養彼如來者，眾苦皆除。
english: When there are women who, at the time of giving birth, experience extreme suffering; if they can wholeheartedly recite the name, pay homage and praise, and respectfully make offerings to that Tathagata, all sufferings will be removed.

chinese: 所生之子，身分具足，形色端正，見者歡喜，利根聰明，安隱少病，無有非人，奪其精氣。
english: The children born will have complete physical form, handsome appearance, bringing joy to those who see them, sharp faculties and intelligence, peaceful and with few illnesses, without evil spirits stealing their vital energy.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告阿難言：「如我稱揚彼佛世尊藥師琉璃光如來所有功德，此是諸佛甚深行處，難可解了，汝為信不？
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Ānanda: "As I have praised the merits and virtues of that Buddha, the World-Honored One Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathāgata, this represents the extremely profound sphere of activity of all Buddhas, which is difficult to comprehend and understand. Do you believe this or not?"

chinese: 爾時，勝軍大王坐一面已，而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: At that time, King Victorious Army, having taken his seat to one side, addressed the Buddha, saying: "Great Compassionate World-Honored One!

chinese: 願如來哀愍教授，惟願善逝哀愍教誡，令我長夜證於大義利益安樂。
english: May the Tathagata compassionately teach and instruct, may the Well-Gone One compassionately admonish and guide, so that I may realize great meaning, benefit, and happiness throughout the long night.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告大王曰：「善哉，善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to the great king: "Excellent, excellent!

chinese: 大王！
english: Great King!

chinese: 汝今乃能請問如來如是大義。
english: You are now able to ask the Tathagata about such great meaning.

chinese: 大王！
english: Great King!

chinese: 汝今為大國主，應以正法勿以邪法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: You are now the ruler of a great nation. You should govern with righteous law, not with evil law. You should follow the proper way, not follow what is improper.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 若有國王或諸王等，棄捨正法以諸邪法而作國王，彼於現在為諸聖賢之所訶毀，後致憂悔，身壞命終墮諸惡趣，生地獄中受諸劇苦；又若國王或諸王等，棄捨邪法以其正法而作國王，彼於現在為眾聖賢之所稱讚，後無憂悔，身壞命終超昇善趣，生諸天中受諸妙樂。
english: If there are kings or various rulers who abandon the righteous Dharma and use various wrong teachings to rule as kings, they will in the present be censured and condemned by all the sages and worthies, later experience worry and regret, and when their bodies decay and their lives end, they will fall into the evil destinies and be born in hell to suffer various intense sufferings. Moreover, if kings or various rulers abandon wrong teachings and use the righteous Dharma to rule as kings, they will in the present be praised by all the sages and worthies, later have no worry or regret, and when their bodies decay and their lives end, they will transcend and ascend to the good destinies, being born among the gods to experience various wonderful pleasures.

chinese: 「大王！
english: "Great King!

chinese: 譬如父母憐愍於子，心常欲令離苦得樂；王亦應爾，於諸國邑所有眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，應以諸佛所說四攝而受之。
english: Just as parents have compassion for their children, always wishing them to be free from suffering and attain happiness; so too should a king be toward all beings in the various cities and towns of the country—servants, workers, ministers, and assistants—receiving them through the four methods of attraction taught by the Buddhas.

chinese: 何等為四？
english: What are the four?

chinese: 一者、布施；二者、愛語；三者、利行；四者、同事。
english: First, giving; second, kind words; third, beneficial conduct; fourth, working together.

chinese: 如是善攝國邑眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，攝於二義同事同歸。
english: Thus skillfully gathering the living beings of the kingdom and cities, servants, workers, ministers, and assistants, bringing them together through two principles to work together toward the same goal.

chinese: 何等二義？
english: What are these two meanings?

chinese: 一者、現在；二者、未來。
english: First, the present; second, the future.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如男子或諸女人，於其夢中夢心所見，可愛園林可愛山谷，可愛國邑并諸異類，彼夢覺已所見皆無。
english: For example, when men or women in their dreams see with their dream consciousness lovely gardens and groves, lovely mountain valleys, lovely cities and towns along with various other things, when they awaken from that dream, all that they saw is non-existent.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命虛偽無常，一切皆如夢之所見。
english: A nation's fortune and one's life are illusory and impermanent; all things are like what is seen in a dream.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King should know!"

chinese: 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步諸軍宮殿，后妃太子諸王，輔臣僚佐防衛士眾，父母兄弟姊妹妻妾，男女大小僮僕作使國邑眾生，金銀珍寶末尼真珠，衣服財穀庫藏等物，如是所有諸欲樂具，於命終時皆當棄捨，獨往後世無一相隨。
english: The king's wealth and happiness, the king's freedom and joy, the king's love and sensual pleasures, and all other instruments of sensual pleasure - namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry and various armies, palaces, queens and consorts, crown princes and various princes, ministers and assistants, guards and retainers, parents, brothers, sisters, wives and concubines, sons and daughters both great and small, servants and attendants, cities and subjects, gold and silver, precious treasures, pearls and gems, clothing and grain stores and treasury goods - all such instruments of sensual pleasure must be abandoned at the time of death, going alone to the next world with nothing to accompany one.

chinese: 「大王知！
english: "Great King, know this!"

chinese: 如上所說一切樂具，非常非恒不可保信，皆變易法迅速不停，流轉移動終歸壞滅，念念遷謝後為灰燼，究竟同趣滅盡之門，是失壞法有諸怖畏、有諸災橫、多諸愁惱，皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之。
english: All the pleasures mentioned above are impermanent, not eternal, and unreliable. They are all subject to change, swift and unceasing, flowing and shifting, ultimately leading to destruction. They pass away moment by moment and eventually turn to ash, all ultimately heading toward the gate of extinction. These are things subject to loss and decay, full of fears, disasters, and sorrows—all falling, scattering, breaking apart, and dispersing.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如樹林先見開華，尋復結果後還無果，先見其葉榮茂青翠，尋復萎黃後皆凋落。
english: Just as with a forest of trees, first one sees the blossoms open, soon after they bear fruit but then become fruitless again; first one sees the leaves flourishing luxuriantly and verdant, soon after they wither and turn yellow, then all fall away.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The nation's fortune and life, the king's wealth and noble pleasures, the king's freedom and pleasures, the king's desires and pleasures, and all other various pleasure objects, namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry armies and such, extensively speaking, even to all of these - they are likewise subject to the law of falling, dropping, scattering, breaking, and dispersing.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如大火聚，先見熾然復極熾然，轉遍熾然後皆洞然，雖久熾盛終歸滅盡。
english: Like a great fire mass, first seen blazing then extremely blazing, spreading to blaze everywhere and finally burning completely through, though long blazing fiercely it ultimately returns to complete extinction.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The life of the kingdom, royal wealth and pleasure, royal freedom and pleasure, royal sensual pleasure, and all other various objects of desire and pleasure, namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry and other troops, and so forth - all of these are likewise subject to the law of falling, scattering, decay, destruction, and dispersion.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如日月輪，有大神用具大勢力，放大光明以自莊嚴，遍照世間終歸隱沒。
english: Like the sun and moon's orbs, possessing great divine power and great might, radiating great brilliance to adorn themselves, illuminating the world before ultimately fading away.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The dynasty's life and fate, the king's wealth and pleasure, the king's freedom and pleasure, the king's desires and pleasures, and all other objects of desire and pleasure, namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry armies and so forth - extensively speaking, all of these are likewise subject to the law of falling, scattering, decay, destruction, separation, and dispersion.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如大雲遍覆虛空，暴風疾雷掣電注雨，震動天地須臾散滅。
english: Like a great cloud covering the entire sky, with violent winds, swift thunder, flashing lightning, and pouring rain, shaking heaven and earth before scattering and disappearing in an instant.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The lifespan of the nation, royal wealth and pleasure, royal freedom and pleasure, royal desires and pleasures, and all other various objects of desire and pleasure, namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry armies and so forth - extensively speaking, all of these are likewise subject to the law of falling, dropping, scattering, destruction, breaking apart, and dispersion.

chinese: 是故，大王！
english: Therefore, Great King!

chinese: 應善勤修，隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀，於自命終常當驚懼，為大國王應以正法勿以非法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: One should diligently cultivate good practice, follow the contemplation of impermanence and the contemplation of cessation and extinction. One should constantly feel alarm and fear regarding the end of one's own life. As a great king, one should govern with righteous law and not with unrighteous law, should follow the Dharma and not follow what is contrary to the Dharma.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如四大山從四方來，牢固堅密無有缺漏無諸間隙，周匝充遍總一合成，上盡虛空下窮地際，其中所有一切草木枝條花葉，及諸有情蠢動之類皆被磨滅，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而可禁止。
english: As if four great mountains came from the four directions, firm and solid with no gaps or openings, no crevices or spaces, surrounding and filling completely to form one unified whole, reaching upward to the limits of empty space and downward to the boundaries of earth, wherein all grasses, trees, branches, flowers and leaves, as well as all sentient beings and moving creatures would be ground to destruction, impossible to escape through decisive courage, impossible to resist through force and power, impossible to prevent through incantations, wealth, or medicines.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 世有四種大怖畏事，各來磨滅一切眾生，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而能禁止。
english: In the world there are four kinds of great frightful things that come to destroy all living beings, difficult to escape through courage and bravery, difficult to resist through power and strength, difficult to prevent through incantations, wealth, or medicines.

chinese: 「云何四種大怖畏事？
english: "What are the four kinds of great fearful things?

chinese: 大王當知！
english: Great King, you should know!

chinese: 一者、老來逼害，磨滅眾生少壯；二者、病來逼害，磨滅眾生調適；三者、死來逼害，磨滅眾生壽命；四者、衰來逼害，磨滅眾生興盛。
english: First, old age comes to oppress and harm, wearing away the youth and vigor of living beings; second, sickness comes to oppress and harm, wearing away the health and well-being of living beings; third, death comes to oppress and harm, wearing away the lifespan of living beings; fourth, decline comes to oppress and harm, wearing away the prosperity of living beings.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如師子為眾獸王，入鹿群中搏取一鹿，若噉未噉自在無難。
english: Like a lion who is king of all beasts, when it enters a herd of deer and seizes one deer, whether it devours it or not, it does so freely without difficulty.

chinese: 其鹿爾時先所騰勇，入師子口無復能為。
english: At that time, the deer's previous bold leaping could no longer help it once it entered the lion's mouth.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生既入無常師子王口，所有勢力無復能為。
english: All sentient beings, having entered the mouth of the lion king of impermanence, no longer have any power to act.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 譬如有人勇健多力毒箭所中，一切威猛皆悉摧滅。
english: Just as a person who is brave, strong, and powerful, when struck by a poisoned arrow, has all their威猛completely destroyed.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生剛強戾，死箭所中無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦渴所逼張口大息，手足紛亂無所堪能，無有勢力涎涕交流，大小便利穢污身體，六根閉塞喉喘息急，良醫拱手棄諸妙藥。
english: All sentient beings are stubborn and obstinate. When struck by the arrow of death, they have no more strength, no more salvation, nothing to rely upon, nowhere to flee. When about to abandon life and the joints dissolve, blood and flesh wither, the heart and chest burn with affliction, pressed by scorching thirst they gasp with mouth agape, hands and feet thrash about helplessly, without strength as saliva and mucus flow together, excrement and urine defile the body, the six sense faculties are blocked, the throat pants with labored breath, good physicians throw up their hands and abandon all wondrous medicines.

chinese: 其所飲噉美味珍饌無不悉捨，偃臥床枕臨往異趣淪沒無際，生老病死無常流，至臨終位餘命無幾，業有力故後有現前。
english: All the delicious and precious foods they consumed, they must abandon completely. Lying on beds and pillows, approaching departure to different realms, sinking into boundless depths, the impermanent flow of birth, aging, sickness, and death. When reaching the moment of death with little life remaining, due to the power of karma, future existence manifests.

chinese: 甚大怖畏琰魔王使，廣大黑闇夜分所吞，出息入息最後將滅，唯獨一身無有第二及餘伴侶，奄背此生歸於後世。
english: Greatly terrified by the messengers of Yama, the King of Death, swallowed by the vast darkness of night, with the final breath about to cease, completely alone with no second self or other companions, suddenly departing this life and proceeding to the afterlife.

chinese: 是大移轉趣大叢林，入大黑闇遊大曠野，泛大溟海業風所飄，往無標記冥方所，當於爾時無異救護、無異歸依、無異投竄，唯除正法。
english: This is the great migration heading toward the great jungle, entering the great darkness and wandering the great wilderness, drifting on the great ocean swept by karmic winds, going to unmarked dark places. At that time there will be no other protection, no other refuge, no other place to hide, except the true Dharma.

chinese: 大王！
english: Great King!

chinese: 彼於爾時，唯有正法能為救、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: At that time, only the True Dharma can serve as rescue, can serve as shelter, can be a refuge - it is what beings rush toward, what they flee to for protection, able to pull sentient beings out of the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如有人寒苦所逼，有煖火日光衣等，所能止息而可獲安；熱苦所逼林泉等；若涉遠道清涼陰；若渴所逼清冷水；若飢所逼多美膳，若病所逼惟良醫藥及供侍者；若怖所逼惟強伴侶。
english: For example, when someone is oppressed by cold and suffering, there are warm fires, sunlight, clothing and such that can provide relief and bring comfort; when oppressed by heat there are forests and springs; when traveling long distances there is cool shade; when oppressed by thirst there is clear cold water; when oppressed by hunger there are many fine meals; when oppressed by illness there are only good physicians, medicine, and attendants; when oppressed by fear there are only strong companions.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生死箭所中，無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦所逼張口，手足紛亂無所堪能，廣說乃至彼於爾時唯有正法，能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: All sentient beings are struck by the arrow of death, having no strength left, no protection, nothing to rely upon, nowhere to flee. When about to abandon life and the joints dissolve, blood and flesh wither, the heart and chest burn with distress, parched and pressed they gasp with open mouths, limbs flailing in confusion, capable of nothing. To elaborate further—at that time only the true Dharma can provide protection, can serve as refuge, can be relied upon, is what one rushes toward and takes shelter in, able to pull sentient beings out of the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖加守護雖久洗飾，雖以眾多上妙飲食恣意飽滿，及至臨終，要當不免飢渴所逼而便捨命。
english: Such a body, though one guards and protects it, though one bathes and adorns it for a long time, though one satisfies it to one's heart's content with abundant fine food and drink, when the time of death arrives, it must inevitably be oppressed by hunger and thirst and then abandon life.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖常澡浴，塗香末香香花鬘隨意嚴飾，由此自體穢漏成故，臨捨命時，終必歸於不淨臭穢。
english: Such a body, though constantly bathed and cleansed, anointed with fragrant oils and powders, adorned with fragrant flowers and garlands as one pleases, because this very form is constituted of filthy discharge, when the time comes to abandon life, it must ultimately return to impurity and foul stench.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖以種種上妙衣服覆蔽纏裹，由此自身諸不淨物所合成故，於命終時，要當不淨種種流出。
english: Such a body, though covered and wrapped with various fine garments, being composed of various impure substances of the body itself, must at the time of death have various impurities flowing out.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室后妃婇女內美人眷屬圍遶，作眾伎樂種種倡，以自娛樂歡喜快樂，臨命終時，自見惡相，要當驚怖憂悲苦惱。
english: Such a body, although dwelling in palaces with empresses, consorts, and beautiful women as dependents surrounding it, performing various entertainments and music to amuse itself with joy and happiness, when the time of death arrives, will see evil omens and will inevitably experience terror, worry, grief, and suffering.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室綵飾畫殿閣樓臺，戶牖軒窓重密掩，種種香花以自嚴飾，種種燈燭光照明，施設珍奇屏障帷幄，燒眾名香散諸妙花，香花寶瓶處處陳列，安置種種金銀琉璃眾寶床座，敷設上妙氍錦繡文蓐花氈，床座兩頭俱置丹枕，覆以上妙綺帊錦衾，寤寐安寢歡娛耽著，於命終後無所覺知，或屍骸置於葬所，烏鵲鵰鷲狐狼野干，餓狗鵄梟諸惡禽獸爭共食噉，骨肉膿血鬚髮糞穢，流溢地上臭處可惡。
english: Though such a body may dwell in palaces with colorful decorations, painted halls, pavilions, and towers, with doors, windows, and casements densely layered and closed, adorned with various fragrant flowers, illuminated by various lamps and candles, furnished with rare and precious screens, curtains, and canopies, with famous incenses burned and wonderful flowers scattered, fragrant flowers and precious vases arranged everywhere, equipped with various beds and seats of gold, silver, lapis lazuli, and precious gems, covered with fine woolen rugs, brocades, embroidered textiles, and flower mats, with red pillows placed at both ends of the beds, covered with fine silk coverlets and brocade quilts, sleeping peacefully and indulging in pleasure and attachment—after death there is no awareness, and whether the corpse is placed in a burial ground, crows, magpies, eagles, vultures, foxes, wolves, jackals, hungry dogs, kites, owls, and various evil birds and beasts compete to devour it, with bones, flesh, pus, blood, hair, and filth flowing over the ground, stinking and loathsome.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 爾時，世尊告文殊師利菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩諮詢如來因地法行，及為末世一切眾生求大乘者，得正住持不墮邪見。
english: You are able to inquire on behalf of all bodhisattvas about the Tathagata's causal ground practices and dharma conduct, and for all beings in the final age who seek the Great Vehicle, to obtain correct maintenance and not fall into wrong views.

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: You must now listen carefully!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I will explain it to you.

chinese: 」時，文殊師利菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva joyfully received the teaching, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good son!"

chinese: 無上法王有大陀羅尼門，名為圓覺，流出一切清淨真如菩提涅槃及教授菩薩。
english: The Supreme Dharma King has a great dhāraṇī gate called Perfect Enlightenment, from which flow forth all pure suchness, bodhi, nirvana, and the teaching of bodhisattvas.

chinese: 一切如來本起因地，皆依圓照清淨覺相，永斷無明方成佛道。
english: All Tathagatas, from their original causal ground, all rely on the perfectly illuminating pure enlightened nature, permanently severing ignorance to accomplish the Buddha Way.

chinese: 云何無明？
english: What is ignorance?

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good sir!

chinese: 一切眾生從無始來種種顛倒，猶如迷人四方易處，妄認四大為自身相，六塵緣影為自心相；譬彼病目見空中花及第二月。
english: All sentient beings since beginningless time have been subject to various delusions, like lost people who mistake the four directions, wrongly taking the four great elements as the characteristics of their own body, and the shadowy reflections of the six sense objects as the characteristics of their own mind; this is like a person with diseased eyes who sees flowers in empty space and a second moon.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 空實無花，病者妄執。
english: Emptiness is truly without flowers; the sick one falsely grasps them.

chinese: 由妄執故，非唯惑此虛空自性，亦復迷彼實花生處，由此妄有輪轉生死，故名無明。
english: Due to false attachment, not only is one deluded about the true nature of empty space, but one is also confused about where real flowers actually grow. Because of this, there is the false existence of cyclic birth and death, therefore it is called ignorance.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good sons!

chinese: 此無明者非實有體，如夢中人夢時非無，及至於醒了無所得；如眾空花滅於虛空，不可說言有定滅處，何以故？
english: This ignorance is not truly substantial in nature. Like a person in a dream who is not non-existent during the dream, but upon awakening obtains nothing at all; like flowers in the sky that vanish in empty space - one cannot say there is a definite place of extinction. Why is this so?

chinese: 無生處故。
english: Because there is no place of birth.

chinese: 一切眾生於無生中，妄見生滅，是故說名輪轉生死。
english: All sentient beings, within the unborn, mistakenly perceive birth and death, therefore it is called the cycle of birth and death.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good son!

chinese: 如來因地修圓覺者，知是空花，即無輪轉，亦無身心受彼生死，非作故無，本性無故。
english: When the Tathagata cultivated perfect enlightenment in the causal ground, knowing these to be sky-flowers, there is no transmigration, nor are there body and mind to undergo birth and death—not non-existent through effort, but non-existent by original nature.

chinese: 彼知覺者猶如虛空，知虛空者即空花相，亦不可說無知覺性。
english: That which knows is like empty space, and that which knows empty space is like flowers in the sky, yet one cannot say there is no knowing nature.

chinese: 有、無俱遣，是名為淨覺隨順。
english: Having and non-having are both discarded - this is called pure awakening in accordance.

chinese: 何以故？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 虛空性故，常不動故，如來藏中無起滅故，無知見故，如法界性究竟圓滿遍十方故；是則名為因地法行。
english: Because of the nature of emptiness, because of constant non-movement, because there is no arising and cessation in the Tathāgatagarbha, because there is no knowledge and views, because the nature of the dharmadhātu is ultimately perfect and pervades the ten directions; this is called the dharma practice of the causal ground.

chinese: 菩薩因此於大乘中發清淨心，末世眾生依此修行不墮邪見。
english: Bodhisattvas therefore develop pure minds in the Mahayana, and sentient beings in the final age who rely on this practice will not fall into wrong views.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「文殊汝當知，一切諸如來，從於本因地，皆以智慧覺，了達於無明。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to restate this meaning, spoke in verse: "Manjusri, you should know that all the Tathagatas, from their original causal ground, all through wisdom and awakening, have fully understood ignorance."

chinese: 知彼如空花，即能免流轉，又如夢中人，醒時不可得。
english: Knowing that is like flowers in the void, one can escape cyclic existence; also like a person in a dream, upon awakening cannot be found.

chinese: 覺者如虛空，平等不動轉，覺遍十方界，即得成佛道。
english: The enlightened one is like empty space, equal and unmoving, with awareness pervading the ten directions, thereby attaining the Buddha Way.

chinese: 眾幻滅無處，成道亦無得，本性圓滿故。
english: All illusions vanish without place, enlightenment is also without attainment, because original nature is perfectly complete.

chinese: 菩薩於此中，能發菩提心，末世諸眾生，修此免邪見。
english: In this, the bodhisattva is able to generate the bodhi mind; sentient beings of the final age, cultivating this, are freed from wrong views.

chinese: 」於是普賢菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then Bodhisattva Samantabhadra arose from his seat in the great assembly, bowed at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated three times to the right, knelt with palms joined, and addressed the Buddha, saying: "Great Compassionate World-Honored One!

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾，及為末世一切眾生修大乘者，聞此圓覺清淨境界，云何修行？
english: I vow for the assembly of bodhisattvas here, and for all beings in the final age who cultivate the Great Vehicle, having heard of this perfect enlightenment's pure realm, how should they practice?

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若彼眾生，知如幻者，身心亦幻，云何以幻還修於幻？
english: If those sentient beings know that all is like an illusion, and body and mind are also illusions, how can they use illusion to cultivate illusion?

chinese: 若諸幻性，一切盡滅，無有心，誰為修行？
english: If all illusory natures were completely extinguished, there would be no mind - who would engage in cultivation?

chinese: 云何復說修行如幻？
english: How can one again speak of cultivating practice as illusory?

chinese: 若諸眾生本不修行，於生死中常居幻化，曾不了知如幻境界，令妄想心云何解脫？
english: If all sentient beings originally do not cultivate practice, constantly dwelling in illusion throughout birth and death, never understanding the illusory realm, how can the deluded mind be liberated?

chinese: 願為末世一切眾生，作何方便漸次修習，令諸眾生永離諸幻。
english: I vow to provide skillful means for all sentient beings in the final age, to practice gradually and progressively, so that all sentient beings may forever abandon all illusions.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: Having spoken thus, he prostrated with his five limbs touching the ground, and made such requests three times from beginning to end.

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普賢菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Bodhisattva Samantabhadra: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，修習菩薩如幻三昧，方便漸次，令諸眾生得離諸幻。
english: You are able to guide bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age in cultivating the bodhisattva's illusion-like samadhi, using skillful means and gradual progression to enable all sentient beings to transcend all illusions.

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: You now listen carefully!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I shall explain it for you.

chinese: 」時，普賢菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Bodhisattva Samantabhadra joyfully received the teaching, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good son!

chinese: 一切眾生種種幻化，皆生如來圓覺妙心，猶如空花從空而有，幻花雖滅空性不壞；眾生幻心還依幻滅，諸幻盡滅覺心不動。
english: All sentient beings' various illusory transformations are born from the Tathagata's perfect enlightenment wondrous mind, just as flowers in the sky arise from emptiness itself; though the illusory flowers perish, the nature of emptiness is not destroyed; sentient beings' illusory minds still depend on illusion for their cessation, and when all illusions are completely extinguished, the enlightened mind remains unmoved.

chinese: 依幻說覺亦名為幻，若說有覺猶未離幻，說無覺者亦復如是。
english: According to illusion, awareness is also called illusion. If one speaks of having awareness, one has not yet departed from illusion. Speaking of having no awareness is likewise the same.

chinese: 是故，幻滅名為不動。
english: Therefore, the cessation of illusion is called immovable.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good son!

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生，應當遠離一切幻化虛妄境界，堅執持遠離心故，心如幻者亦復遠離，遠離為幻亦復遠離，離遠離幻亦復遠離，得無所離即除諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age should distance themselves from all illusory and false realms. Because they firmly maintain the mind that distances itself, they should also distance themselves from the mind that is like an illusion. They should also distance themselves from taking distancing as illusion. They should also distance themselves from being apart from distancing and illusion. When there is nothing left to distance oneself from, all illusions are eliminated.

chinese: 譬如鑽火兩木相因，火出木盡灰飛煙滅；以幻修幻亦復如是，諸幻雖盡不入斷滅。
english: Just as when drilling for fire, two pieces of wood depend on each other—when fire emerges, the wood is consumed, ash flies away, and smoke vanishes; cultivating illusion through illusion is likewise—though all illusions are exhausted, one does not fall into nihilistic extinction.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good son!

chinese: 知幻即離，不作方便；離幻即覺，亦無漸次。
english: Knowing illusion is itself separation, requiring no skillful means; separating from illusion is itself awakening, with no gradual stages.

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生依此修行，如是乃能永離諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age who rely on this practice will thus be able to permanently leave behind all illusions.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「普賢汝當知，一切諸眾生，無始幻無明，皆從諸如來，圓覺心建立。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to restate this meaning, spoke in verse: "Samantabhadra, you should know that all sentient beings, with beginningless illusory ignorance, are all established from the perfect enlightened mind of the Tathagatas."

chinese: 猶如虛空花，依空而有相，空花若復滅，虛空本不動。
english: Just like flowers in empty space, they depend on emptiness to have form; when the flowers in emptiness perish again, the void itself is fundamentally unmoved.

chinese: 幻從諸覺生，幻滅覺圓滿，覺心不動故。
english: Illusion arises from various perceptions, when illusion ceases awareness becomes complete, because the aware mind does not move.

chinese: 若彼諸菩薩，及末世眾生，常應遠離幻，諸幻悉皆離。
english: If those bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age constantly keep away from illusions, then all illusions will be completely abandoned.

chinese: 如木中生火，木盡火還滅，覺無漸次，方便亦如是。
english: Like fire arising from wood, when the wood is exhausted the fire is also extinguished; awakening has no gradual stages, and skillful means are also like this.

chinese: 」於是普眼菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then Bodhisattva Universal Eye arose from his seat in the great assembly, bowed at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated three times to the right, knelt with palms joined, and addressed the Buddha, saying: "Greatly Compassionate World-Honored One!

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾及為末世一切眾生，演說菩薩修行漸次，云何思惟？
english: I vow for the assembly of bodhisattvas here and for all sentient beings of the final age to expound the gradual stages of bodhisattva cultivation. How should one contemplate?

chinese: 云何住持？
english: How does one maintain and sustain?

chinese: 眾生未悟作何方便普令開悟？
english: How can expedient means be used to universally cause all sentient beings who have not yet awakened to become enlightened?

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若彼眾生無正方便及正思惟，聞佛如來說此三昧心生迷悶，於圓覺不能悟入。
english: If those sentient beings lack proper skillful means and right contemplation, upon hearing the Buddha Tathagata expound this samadhi, their minds become confused and bewildered, and they cannot awaken to and enter perfect enlightenment.

chinese: 願興慈悲，為我等輩及末世眾生假說方便。
english: May you arouse compassion and expediently teach for the sake of us and all beings of the final age.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: Having spoken these words, he prostrated himself with his five limbs touching the ground, making such entreaties three times from beginning to end.

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普眼菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Bodhisattva Universal Eye: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent! Well done!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good son!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，問於如來修行漸次、思惟、住持乃至假說種種方便，汝今諦聽！
english: You are able to ask the Tathagata on behalf of all bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age about the gradual stages of cultivation, contemplation, maintaining practice, and even the various skillful means of provisional teachings. Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I shall explain it for you.

chinese: 」時，普眼菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Bodhisattva Universal Eye joyfully received the teaching, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good son!

chinese: 彼新學菩薩及末世眾生，欲求如來淨圓覺心，應當正念遠離諸幻，先依如來奢摩他行，堅持禁戒，安處徒眾，宴坐室，作是念：『我今此身四大和合，所謂髮毛、爪齒、皮肉、筋骨、髓腦、垢色皆歸於地，唾涕、膿血、津液、涎沫、痰淚、精氣、大小便利皆歸於水，暖氣歸火，動轉歸風。
english: Those new bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the latter age who wish to seek the Tathagata's pure and perfect enlightened mind should maintain right mindfulness, distance themselves from all illusions, and first follow the Tathagata's samatha practice. They should firmly uphold the precepts, settle their disciples, sit quietly in meditation chambers, and contemplate thus: "This present body of mine is a combination of the four great elements. Hair, skin, nails, teeth, flesh, sinews, bones, marrow, brain, and bodily impurities all return to earth. Saliva, nasal discharge, pus, blood, bodily fluids, foam, phlegm, tears, vital essence, and urine and feces all return to water. Warmth returns to fire, and movement returns to wind."

chinese: 四大各離，今者妄身當在何處？
english: When the four great elements each separate, where will this illusory body now be?

chinese: 其樹有種種葉，如真多摩尼。
english: Its trees have various leaves, like true jewels.

chinese: 樹形於上繫種種繒綵，或繫吠瑠璃寶天菓妙衣，或垂雲降雨。
english: Trees are adorned above with various silk banners and colorful decorations, or hung with vaidurya gems, celestial fruits, and wonderful garments, or dropping clouds and rain.

chinese: 有種種芽，吉祥眾鳥並坐其上。
english: There are various kinds of sprouts, with auspicious birds sitting together upon them.
